definition: A supervised learning algorithm that finds the optimal hyperplane separating classes of data with the maximum margin between them.
details: SVMs were a dominant approach for classification tasks before the deep learning era, and remain useful for smaller datasets or when strong theoretical guarantees are desired.
story: Picture a librarian organizing a million slips of paper so that any one of them can be found in a heartbeat. The examples a machine reads become the world it believes in. Better ingredients make a better meal, and the same is true here. Garbage in, garbage out — and the reverse: clean, representative data makes the model quietly brilliant. That care with the raw material is Support Vector Machine.
